data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Monday, October 12, 2026: How bond yields 'threaten' crypto prices
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $83,673.01 on Monday, October 12, 2026, up 0.9% from Sunday's opening price. As of 7:25 a.m. ET this morning, bitcoin dipped to $83,280.11.
